g.text: Motion classes across the M7 / M4 boundary
shared progress and installed stopping branch
local reference or interaction; bus mediation is labelled
dependency or serialized wire interaction, as labelled
No pointer, callback, future or C++ object is shared across the core boundary.
Both builds compile the same contracts; each application owns its private objects.
Axis forwards to Robot. Raw/homing use StepperMotor; finite axis/robot programs use Executor.
Robot jobs reserve all axes. Motor / Axis / Robot command families exclude each other.
Each Bridge uses a local InterCoreTransport; no cross-core method calls occur.
Normal: io/trajectory, io/motion, io/motor/motion. Urgent: io/trajectory/control, io/motor/stop.
Selected classes and responsibilities; separate instances and address spaces on each core.
2026-11-06 | Current source structure; hardware qualification remains incomplete.
